data.one_liner: CLI tool to automatically generate missing translations for ARB files using AI models.
data.what_it_does: arb_translate is a command-line tool that automatically generates missing translations in ARB files. It integrates with Google Gemini, OpenAI ChatGPT, Vertex AI, or custom OpenAI-compatible models to populate translation files based on a template ARB.
use_when: You use Flutter's localizations and ARB files and want to automate adding missing translations.
You want to leverage AI models like Gemini or ChatGPT for application localization.
avoid_when: You do not use ARB files for localization.
You prefer manual translation writing for quality control.
strengths: Supports multiple AI providers including Gemini, ChatGPT, Vertex AI, and custom models.
Seamlessly integrates with existing l10n.yaml configurations used by Flutter apps.
weaknesses: Relies on external AI services which require API keys and may incur costs.
AI-generated translations may occasionally require manual review and correction.
data.setup_notes: Activate via pub global, obtain an API key from Google or OpenAI, and configure it via environment variables or l10n.yaml.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate arb_translate
arb_translate
